text: つぎに　クチバに　くる　のは　らいねんの　いまごろ　じゃな…

structure.jp: つぎに　クチバに　くる　のは
structure.en: the next time it comes to Vermilion

structure.jp: らいねんの　いまごろ　じゃな…
structure.en: will be about this time next year...

patterns.name: 〜の (nominalizer)
patterns.explanation: の after a verb turns the whole action into a thing you can talk about; here it stands for 'the time when'. つぎに　クチバに　くる　のは = 'the next time it comes to Vermilion'.

patterns.name: 〜だ
patterns.explanation: じゃ is the old-man way of saying だ, 'is'. いまごろ　じゃな = 'it'll be about this time, I suppose'.
